headline: Harvey Lock closed again – low river
dateline: Since Oct 22 · no reopening time yet
what: Harvey Lock shut again Oct 22 because of reverse head from the low Mississippi. The Corps has given no reopening estimate.
why: Everything moving between the river and the GIWW west of New Orleans now squeezes through Algiers Lock.
todo: Route via Algiers Lock, expect waits behind tows, and hail the lock on VHF before you commit.
source: American Commercial Barge Line river report

tag: Atlantic coast · Fernandina to Jupiter, FL
headline: Gale watch for Florida's Atlantic coast
dateline: Sat afternoon Oct 24 – Mon evening Oct 26
what: NE winds 25–35 kt, gusts to 40, seas 10–15 ft possible off Fernandina–Flagler; gale watches run south to Jupiter Inlet.
why: No outside hops between inlets this weekend, and NE swell will make the inlets dangerous. Higher tides cut fixed-bridge clearance.
todo: Stay inside on the ICW, double your lines, and recheck weather.gov Saturday morning – a watch can become a warning.

headline: Melges 15 Gulf Coast Championship
what: Bay-Waveland Yacht Club hosts two days of Melges 15 one-design dinghy racing on the Mississippi Sound.
why: Quick, close racing near shore off Bay St. Louis – easy to watch if you're in the harbor this weekend.
todo: Watch from the harbor or beach and give the course room. Club: 228-467-4592. A small craft advisory starts Saturday.
